command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $remote=@'
set +e
cd /home/ubuntu/mei-mg-email || exit 2
echo CHECK_BRT=$(TZ=America/Sao_Paulo date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z)
sentinel=absent; sudo test -f /var/lib/mei-mg-email/sender_blocked.pause && sentinel=present
as42004=$(sudo journalctl -u mei-mg-email-worker.service --since '-30 minutes' --no-pager | grep -Eic 'AS\(42004\)|bad outbound sender|5\.1\.8' || true)
echo SENTINEL=$sentinel; echo AS42004_30M=$as42004
echo WORKER=$(sudo systemctl is-active mei-mg-email-worker.service 2>/dev/null || true)
echo WORKER_ENABLED=$(sudo systemctl is-enabled mei-mg-email-worker.service 2>/dev/null || true)
echo NDR_GUARD=$(sudo systemctl is-active mei-mg-email-ndr-guard.service 2>/dev/null || true)
echo NDR_GUARD_ENABLED=$(sudo systemctl is-enabled mei-mg-email-ndr-guard.service 2>/dev/null || true)
echo AUTOREPAIR=$(sudo systemctl is-active mei-mg-email-autorepair.timer 2>/dev/null || true)
sudo systemctl show mei-mg-email-worker.service -p Restart -p RestartUSec -p StartLimitIntervalUSec -p ExecStart --no-pager
if ! sudo docker exec mei-mg-email-db pg_isready -U postgres -d mei_mg_email >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo DB_RECOVERY=started; sudo docker compose up -d db; for i in $(seq 1 30); do sudo docker exec mei-mg-email-db pg_isready -U postgres -d mei_mg_email >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 2; done; fi
if sudo docker exec mei-mg-email-db pg_isready -U postgres -d mei_mg_email >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo DB_READY=true; else echo DB_READY=false; fi
getent hosts graph.microsoft.com >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo GRAPH_DNS=ok || echo GRAPH_DNS=fail
echo GRAPH_HTTPS=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 10 -w '%{http_code}' https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/ 2>/dev/null || echo fail)
.venv/bin/python -c "from app.email_provider import MicrosoftGraphEmailProvider; MicrosoftGraphEmailProvider()._get_access_token(); print('GRAPH_AUTH=ok')" 2>/dev/null || echo GRAPH_AUTH=fail
q(){ sudo docker exec mei-mg-email-db psql -X -U postgres -d mei_mg_email -At -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "set statement_timeout='15s'; $1" 2>&1 | tail -n 1; }
if sudo docker exec mei-mg-email-db pg_isready -U postgres -d mei_mg_email >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 q "select 'SENT24_MAIN='||count(*) from mei_email.envios where status::text in ('submitted','enviado') and enviado_em>=now()-interval '24 hours';"
 q "select 'OPEN_TOTAL='||count(*) from mei_email.envios where status::text in ('pendente','enviando','pending','processing');"
 q "select 'LAST_SENT='||coalesce(max(enviado_em)::text,'') from mei_email.envios where status::text in ('submitted','enviado');"
 q "select 'STRICT_ELIGIBLE='||count(*) from mei_email.vw_empresas_elegiveis;"
 q "select 'COPY_LEGACY='||count(*) from mei_email.campanhas where corpo_template ilike '%base pública de CNPJ%';"
 q "select 'TRG_COPY='||count(*) from pg_trigger where not tgisinternal and tgname='trg_campaign_copy_policy';"
 q "select 'TRG_LIVE='||count(*) from pg_trigger where not tgisinternal and tgname='trg_envio_live_eligibility';"
 q "select 'OPEN_REPLAY='||count(*) from mei_email.envios e where e.status::text in ('pendente','enviando','pending','processing') and exists(select 1 from mei_email.envios p where p.id<>e.id and (p.cnpj=e.cnpj or lower(btrim(p.email::text))=lower(btrim(e.email::text))) and p.status::text in ('submitted','enviado','delivered'));"
 q "select 'ORPHAN_ROWS='||count(*) from mei_email.envios e left join mei_email.lotes l on l.id=e.lote_id left join mei_email.campanhas c on c.id=e.campanha_id where l.id is null or c.id is null;"
 q "select 'HARD_BOUNCE_ACTIVE='||count(*) from mei_email.email_suppressions where active and reason='hard_bounce';"
 q "select 'LOCK_WAITERS='||count(*) from pg_locks where not granted;"
 q "select 'ADVISORY_LOCKS='||count(*) from pg_locks where locktype='advisory' and granted;"
 q "select 'LONG_ACTIVE='||count(*) from pg_stat_activity where pid<>pg_backend_pid() and state='active' and query_start<now()-interval '30 seconds';"
 q "select 'SYNTH_AUTH_TRUE='||count(*) from mei_email.empresas where marketing_autorizado is true and btrim(coalesce(marketing_autorizado_origem,'')) in ('user_explicit_authorization_2026-08-20','user_campaign_authorization_2026-08-20');"
 q "select 'FLYWAY_37_38='||coalesce(string_agg(version,',' order by installed_rank),'') from public.flyway_schema_history where version in ('37','38');"
fi
if [ "$sentinel" = absent ] && [ "$as42004" -eq 0 ]; then
 sudo systemctl enable mei-mg-email-worker.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 [ "$(sudo systemctl is-active mei-mg-email-worker.service 2>/dev/null)" = active ] || { sudo systemctl reset-failed mei-mg-email-worker.service || true; sudo systemctl restart mei-mg-email-worker.service || true; }
 sudo systemctl enable mei-mg-email-ndr-guard.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 [ "$(sudo systemctl is-active mei-mg-email-ndr-guard.service 2>/dev/null)" = active ] || sudo systemctl restart mei-mg-email-ndr-guard.service || true
 .venv/bin/python scripts/nonstop_supervisor_15m.py || true
fi
echo WORKER_AFTER=$(sudo systemctl is-active mei-mg-email-worker.service 2>/dev/null || true)
echo WORKER_ENABLED_AFTER=$(sudo systemctl is-enabled mei-mg-email-worker.service 2>/dev/null || true)
echo NDR_GUARD_AFTER=$(sudo systemctl is-active mei-mg-email-ndr-guard.service 2>/dev/null || true)
echo SUPERVISOR_STATE; sudo cat /var/lib/mei-mg-email/throughput-supervisor-state.json 2>/dev/null || true
'@; Write-Output ('FREDWIN_HOST=' + $env:COMPUTERNAME); & ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=15 shopvivaliz-vm $remote; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('SSH_RC=' + $rc); exit 0
reason: Fresh fail-safe MEI audit: verify nonstop worker, DB, Graph, queue, V037/V038 guards, locks, authorized pool and hard-bounce state; recover worker/NDR guard only without Microsoft sender block
